parameters.query:
INSERT INTO users (
    user_id,
    display_name
)
VALUES (
    'demo-user-001',
    'Demo Investor'
)
ON CONFLICT (user_id)
DO UPDATE SET
    display_name = EXCLUDED.display_name,
    updated_at = NOW();


INSERT INTO user_financial_profiles (
    user_id,
    current_age,
    current_portfolio_value,
    monthly_investment,
    risk_tolerance,
    preferred_sectors,
    excluded_sectors,
    inflation_rate,
    pre_retirement_return,
    withdrawal_rate,
    updated_at
)
VALUES (
    'demo-user-001',
    45,
    795500,
    8000,
    'moderate',
    ARRAY[
        'Technology',
        'Healthcare'
    ],
    ARRAY[]::TEXT[],
    0.025,
    0.060,
    0.040,
    NOW()
)
ON CONFLICT (user_id)
DO UPDATE SET
    current_age = EXCLUDED.current_age,
    current_portfolio_value =
        EXCLUDED.current_portfolio_value,
    monthly_investment =
        EXCLUDED.monthly_investment,
    risk_tolerance =
        EXCLUDED.risk_tolerance,
    preferred_sectors =
        EXCLUDED.preferred_sectors,
    excluded_sectors =
        EXCLUDED.excluded_sectors,
    inflation_rate =
        EXCLUDED.inflation_rate,
    pre_retirement_return =
        EXCLUDED.pre_retirement_return,
    withdrawal_rate =
        EXCLUDED.withdrawal_rate,
    updated_at = NOW();


INSERT INTO portfolio_holdings (
    user_id,
    ticker,
    quantity,
    average_cost,
    current_price,
    sector,
    updated_at
)
VALUES
    (
        'demo-user-001',
        'AAPL',
        1000,
        180,
        225,
        'Technology',
        NOW()
    ),
    (
        'demo-user-001',
        'MSFT',
        500,
        350,
        420,
        'Technology',
        NOW()
    ),
    (
        'demo-user-001',
        'VTI',
        1000,
        240,
        275,
        'Broad Market ETF',
        NOW()
    ),
    (
        'demo-user-001',
        'JNJ',
        300,
        150,
        165,
        'Healthcare',
        NOW()
    ),
    (
        'demo-user-001',
        'BND',
        500,
        70,
        72,
        'Bond ETF',
        NOW()
    )
ON CONFLICT (
    user_id,
    ticker
)
DO UPDATE SET
    quantity = EXCLUDED.quantity,
    average_cost = EXCLUDED.average_cost,
    current_price = EXCLUDED.current_price,
    sector = EXCLUDED.sector,
    updated_at = NOW();


SELECT
    user_id,
    COUNT(*) AS holding_count,
    ROUND(
        SUM(
            quantity * current_price
        ),
        2
    ) AS total_market_value,
    ROUND(
        SUM(
            quantity * average_cost
        ),
        2
    ) AS total_cost_basis,
    ROUND(
        SUM(
            quantity *
            (
                current_price -
                average_cost
            )
        ),
        2
    ) AS unrealized_gain_loss
FROM portfolio_holdings
WHERE user_id = 'demo-user-001'
GROUP BY user_id;
